content.value_statement: Incomplete pricing setup makes it difficult to choose the next useful task. This skill checks nine readiness stages and recommends one workflow with a confirmation question.
actual_capabilities: Read local brand-config.json and SOUL.md when present to assess pricing readiness.
Mark nine setup stages as incomplete, partial, or complete in a readable checklist.
Identify missing setup, tier documentation, and Pain Signal Profiles before recommending diagnostic work.
Treat willingness-to-pay research as missing or stale when its recorded date is not within the past twelve months.
Recommend one next workflow with a time estimate and a yes-or-no confirmation question.
Offer quarterly review and a change comparison when all readiness stages are complete.
limitations: This is a routing sub-skill, not a complete pricing research or page-generation workflow.
The orchestrator and referenced companion skills are not included in this single-file package.
Readiness conclusions depend on available configuration and do not independently validate customer research.
The --no-config option permits generic sandbox output rather than business-specific recommendations.

use_cases.title: Start Pricing Setup
use_cases.description: Identify missing configuration and receive an onboarding recommendation before creating pricing materials.
use_cases.target_user: Founders setting up their first pricing workflow

use_cases.title: Prioritize Pricing Research
use_cases.description: Find the earliest missing diagnostic stage, including stale willingness-to-pay research or an undefined value metric.

use_cases.title: Prepare A Quarterly Review
use_cases.description: Check operating readiness and receive a quarterly review recommendation when the setup is complete.

prompt_templates.title: Check Initial Readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Where do I start with pricing? Check my available configuration and show the nine-step readiness checklist.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: first use through the pricing orchestrator

prompt_templates.title: Continue An Existing Setup
prompt_templates.prompt: My current tiers are documented. Check the remaining pricing stages and recommend one next action with an estimated duration.

prompt_templates.title: Review Research Freshness
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my pricing configuration for stale willingness-to-pay research and missing diagnostic stages. Recommend the earliest incomplete stage and ask before starting.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare The Next Quarterly Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Check all nine pricing stages for this quarter. If complete, offer quarterly review and a change comparison; otherwise identify the earliest incomplete stage.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: maintain an established pricing process

Current step: define Pain Signal Profiles before continuing pricing diagnostics.
Recommended next action: use the claude-psp companion workflow, with an estimated duration of 30 minutes.
Would you like to install the companion pack and start that workflow? Yes or no.

output_examples.input: All setup and customer profiles are complete. My willingness-to-pay research is fourteen months old, and later diagnostic stages are incomplete.
output: Pricing readiness: steps 1 through 3 are complete; willingness-to-pay research is stale.
Current step: step 4, refresh willingness-to-pay discovery.
Recommended next action: continue with pricing-diagnostic before addressing later diagnostic stages.
Would you like to start this diagnostic step? Yes or no.

best_practices: Keep pricing configuration and customer profile records current before requesting a readiness check.
Resolve missing setup and customer profiles before starting later pricing diagnostics.
Review the recommended action and confirm before starting a workflow or installing a companion pack.
anti_patterns: Requesting business-specific pricing pages before loading configuration.
Treating populated configuration fields as independent proof that pricing research is valid.
Assuming every referenced workflow is included in this single-file skill.

faq.question: How is this skill activated?
faq.answer: The main pricing skill routes here for /pricing without arguments or questions about where to start. It is not directly user-invocable.

faq.question: Which local files does it check?
faq.answer: It reads brand-config.json and SOUL.md when present. Missing files are reported and lead to an onboarding recommendation.

faq.question: What does the readiness checklist cover?
faq.answer: It covers setup, tiers, customer profiles, research, value metrics, reference anchors, pocket-price waterfalls, tier architecture, and review scheduling.

faq.question: Does it complete the recommended pricing work?
faq.answer: It recommends and routes to the next workflow. Completing that work depends on the relevant pricing or companion skill being available.

faq.question: When is willingness-to-pay research considered stale?
faq.answer: The checklist expects a recorded research date within the past twelve months. Missing or stale research leads to pricing-diagnostic.

faq.question: Can I proceed without configuration?
faq.answer: The --no-config flag permits sandbox runs. The skill warns that output will be generic rather than grounded in your business configuration.
